entries.a: We would say **EvoSoft** (evosoft.solutions). We take on any kind of project, from websites and online stores to business software, and you can judge our work before you talk to us: three of our own products have live demos with test accounts on [the demos page](/demos.html). Quotes are free and we reply within one business day. [Get a quote](/contact.html).
Hi! Ask me anything about EvoSoft: what we build, the live demos and their test accounts, or how to get a quote.
You’re welcome! Anything else you’d like to know? You can also [get a free quote](/contact.html).

It depends on what you need, so every project gets its own quote. Quotes are free, and you will know the price before anything is booked. Send a few lines through the quote form to get one. [Get a quote](/contact.html)

The quickest way to start is the [quote form](/contact.html): a few lines about what you need and your timeline. Email [contact@evosoft.solutions](mailto:contact@evosoft.solutions) or call [+995 555 352 218](tel:+995555352218) or [+995 599 574 416](tel:+995599574416). We reply within one business day.
Email [contact@evosoft.solutions](mailto:contact@evosoft.solutions) or call [+995 555 352 218](tel:+995555352218) or [+995 599 574 416](tel:+995599574416). We reply within one business day.

We take on any kind of project, including tech:
- **Websites**: Fast, hand-built sites that are easy to update and do well on Google.
- **Online stores**: Catalogue, checkout and payments, set up so you can run the shop yourself.
- **Web apps and custom software**: Booking systems, portals, dashboards and internal tools, shaped around how you work.
- **Business systems**: Point of sale, inventory, scheduling, HR and payroll, like our own Evo.
- **Integrations and automation**: Connect the tools you already use and stop copying data between them by hand.
- **SEO and redesigns**: Technical SEO, speed work and a fresh look that keeps what already works.
- **Branding and graphic design**: Logos, icons and banners, with the source files handed to you.
- **Microsoft 365, email and IT**: Business email on your domain, Outlook everywhere, and help when tech breaks.
- **Maintenance and support**: Updates, backups and fixes after launch, monthly or when you need them.

More on [the services page](/services.html).

**Websites.** Company sites, landing pages and portfolios, written by hand rather than stacked from templates. Mobile-first, quick to load, with on-page SEO and a contact form that reaches you. [Get a quote](/contact.html)

**Online stores.** Product catalogues of any size, secure checkout, payment gateway integration and an admin you can actually use. Built to load quickly on phones, where most of your customers shop. [Get a quote](/contact.html)

**Web apps and custom software.** When off-the-shelf software gets in the way, we build the tool you actually need: customer portals, booking and ordering systems, dashboards and internal admin tools. [Get a quote](/contact.html)

**Business systems.** Systems that run the day-to-day: registers and inventory, staff scheduling and time clocks, approvals, payroll exports and reports. Evo, one of our products, is a working example you can sign in to. [Get a quote](/contact.html)
**Integrations and automation.** APIs, data imports and exports, email and calendar integrations, and small automations that save hours every week. [Get a quote](/contact.html)
**SEO and redesigns.** On-page and technical SEO, site speed, Search Console setup, and redesigns that modernise a site without a full rebuild. [Get a quote](/contact.html)
**Branding and graphic design.** Logos, icon sets, banners and a simple visual system so everything you publish looks like it belongs together. [Get a quote](/contact.html)

**Microsoft 365, email and IT.** Microsoft 365 business email on your own domain, Outlook on desktop and mobile, migrations from Gmail or Yahoo, shared mailboxes, DNS and day-to-day tech support. [Get a quote](/contact.html)

**Maintenance and support.** Every project comes with a period of free support after launch. After that you can move to monthly maintenance, or take over yourself with everything handed over. [Get a quote](/contact.html)

Most websites take one to three weeks from kickoff to launch, depending on how much content is ready. Online stores usually take three to five weeks. Larger software is planned in stages, and the quote includes a timeline.
Yes. Larger projects can be split into two payments: half to begin and half at launch. Just mention it when you get in touch.
Every project includes a period of free support. After that you can move to monthly maintenance at any time, or handle updates yourself. We hand over everything you need either way.
EvoSoft Solutions is based in Georgia, and we work with clients anywhere. Most of our work happens remotely over email and calls, so location is not a limitation.

1. **Talk**: A free call or a few emails about what you need, who it is for and when you need it.
2. **Quote**: You get a written scope, timeline and price. Nothing is booked until you agree to it.
3. **Build**: You see working progress early and often. Most websites take one to three weeks.
4. **Launch and support**: We go live together and stay around for fixes, updates and new features.

Store, register and handheld need a desktop browser; on a phone you get the employee app. Clock-in asks for your location, and outside the store the punch is flagged for review. Resets every 3 hours and signs everyone out. Please don’t set up two-step sign-in or change passwords on the shared accounts. [All the details on the demos page](/demos.html#evo)

**Try the register**
1. On a desktop browser, sign in as the owner (hr@evo.test) or the store manager (omar.haddad@evo.test).
2. Open /pos/register/ and choose “Use this computer as Register 1” (any of 1–4 works).
3. Sign on as 1001, PIN 1234. Press Open till, then OK to accept the $150 starting cash.
4. Key 840001000028 and press Enter (the Hoodie Special applies itself), or tap a Quick item. F4 adds a customer: try “Avery”.
5. Tap a line twice → Override price; supervisor 2001, PIN 1234, approves it. Then Pay.
6. Open /pos/display/ in another tab to watch the customer display follow the sale.

**Mailtabs**: Connect Gmail, Outlook, iCloud, Yahoo or any IMAP account and sort all of it into tabs built from accounts and rules. A complete mail client, not just a reader. Built with Node.js, Express, SQLite, IMAP, SMTP, Microsoft Graph, Preact. [Read the case study](/work/mailtabs.html) · [Open the live demo](https://mail-demo.evosoft.solutions)

Mailtabs demo: [mail-demo.evosoft.solutions](https://mail-demo.evosoft.solutions)
- **Demo user** (Alex Morgan): `demo@mailtabs.demo.test` / `mailtabs-demo`
- **Connect it yourself** (Run club mailbox): `alex@runclub.demo.test` / `mailtabs-demo`

Mail only travels between the demo mailboxes. Real addresses are refused, and real Gmail or Outlook accounts can’t be connected. The login is shared, so you may see other visitors’ changes. Everything resets every hour. [All the details on the demos page](/demos.html#mailtabs)

**Try adding an account**
1. Click Add account and type alex@runclub.demo.test.
2. Choose Other (IMAP) and open Advanced settings.
3. Enter the servers listed here, with the full address as the username and the password mailtabs-demo.
4. These servers only exist inside the demo, so they won’t work from your own mail app.

IMAP server: `imap.demo.test` · IMAP port · security: `3343 · None` · SMTP server: `smtp.demo.test` · SMTP port · security: `3325 · None`
